_doc: The one press plan (M3): what every pressing bot and the game's autopilot press in a campaign fight, and when. Read by logic/Sim/PressPlan.cs. Generic rules: the grip held at the hover target (the nearest foe within its reach + gripPad); a spender pressed when its condition holds and Resolve pays, and always once Resolve is at spendFullAt of its cap (spend when full); a wait skill pressed when ready and its condition holds. Per skill: priority (lower first), when (KindleDef shape: crowd/windup/hurt/block, count, radius, within, big, any), aim (hover: nearest foe in reach; pack: the center of the densest pack, packRadius/packMin; line: the line through the most, line/lineHalf/lineMin; self). Bladestorm (aim storm, bd-storm 13 Nov): started on its when (count within radius; never at full Resolve alone, never below startResolve), held while thinBelow or more stand within holdRadius, broken once breakLines lines are pending, breakLate s before Resolve runs dry (its cap without Resolve), or with fewer than thinBelow left and a line down; spun out with lines pending, broken within its window.
